name: What is the typical timeline for an accessible outlet installation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for an accessible outlet installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an accessible outlet installation project can vary. For adding a few outlets during a full kitchen remodel, it's integrated into the overall project schedule, typically weeks. If it's a standalone project in an existing kitchen, installation of a few outlets might take 1-3 days, including wall preparation and finishing. Larger projects involving significant electrical panel upgrades or multiple new circuits could extend this to several days or even a week, depending on the complexity.
acceptedAnswer.description: A few outlets can take 1-3 days; larger projects with new circuits or panel upgrades may take longer, especially if integrated into a full remodel.
